issue_context.title: Different error message for disabled autoinstall
issue_context.body:
# 🐛 bug report

At the moment, the error message for `parcel build --no-autoinstall` and
- a missing parcel plugin specified in the config that usually would get autoinstalled (e.g. the SASS transformer) or
- `packageManager.resolve` and `packageManager.require`

is just `Cannot find module foo, did you mean bar`.

In this case, it should say something along the lines of `Autoinstall is disabled, please install foo yourself`.

# Relevant code

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/3baf990a686d1c1dd0c5f4360296de890cc00c47/packages/core/core/src/loadParcelPlugin.js#L82-L126
comments: @mischnic I would like to fix this. Please guide me on reproducing this issue. I'm a beginner.

1. `yarn add parcel@nightly`
2. Create a `style.scss` file
3. Running `yarn parcel build style.scss --no-autoinstall` should fail with an error message because `@parcel/transformer-sass` isn't installed and autoinstall is disabled.

---

I just noticed that we already have an error message for this:

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/3baf990a686d1c1dd0c5f4360296de890cc00c47/packages/core/package-manager/src/NodePackageManager.js#L156

but somehow that branch doesn't execute in this case.
@mischnic  I guess if the loadParcelPlugin error is not thrown, the other one would have worked fine. Thoughts?

I think we should just add this hint

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/3baf990a686d1c1dd0c5f4360296de890cc00c47/packages/core/package-manager/src/NodePackageManager.js#L156

to 

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/3baf990a686d1c1dd0c5f4360296de890cc00c47/packages/core/core/src/loadParcelPlugin.js#L102-L125

if autoinstall is disabled.

What I understood so far is that - 

either we should add the hint as you mentioned which would display both `Cannot find module foo, did you mean bar` AND `Auto install is disabled. please install this package manually and restart Parcel`.

OR

Debug and make it throw the error from -
https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/3baf990a686d1c1dd0c5f4360296de890cc00c47/packages/core/core/src/loadParcelPlugin.js#L82-L126

Then write the test case in -
https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/afaab71ab78035a88f8a92471f7d6e514e45b4cc/packages/core/package-manager/test/NodePackageManager.test.js

Thoughts?

Not sure if that is what you're asking, but but the "Auto install is disabled. please install..." hint should only be printed if the package isn't already installed and autoinstall is disabled. Not if autoinstall is enabled but that package doesn't actually
